newsitem.title: UK: Sema drops, still unsettled by EDS tumble.
newsitem.headline: Sema drops, still unsettled by EDS tumble.

text.p: Shares in computer services group Sema Group Plc dropped on Tuesday, dragged lower by recent sharp falls in U.S. rival Electronic Data Systems (EDS), dealers said.

Sema shares dropped 45p to 11.82-1/2 stg by 0912 GMT in volume of 150,579 shares, unsettled by last Friday's 20 percent tumble in EDS after the company reported first quarter earnings that were sharply below Wall Street expectations.
Elsewhere in the sector Logica Plc was down 14p at 916p.
Dealers also cited a sizeable seller in the market of often-volatile Sema stock as being a contributor the weakness in the share price.
Shares in Sema have fallen steadily in the last month from a year's high of 14.35 stg on March 14, when Dresdner Kleinwort Benson downgraded the stock to a "hold" from a "buy".
